title: 第19章 祈山江家第20章 除尽苏家余孽
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: 江家，是一个新兴家族，其于百余年前兴起。
族中，现有着一位肉身境大圆满修士坐镇。
其实力在白河县仅次于九大家族。
不，现在是八大家族了。
江家的大本营在白河县东南方向的祈山镇。
时值黄昏，夕阳西下。
江家大门前，两个守卫负手跨立，目不斜视，几个家仆慢悠悠的打扫着朱门前的落叶。
一个中年模样的乞丐一瘸一拐的靠近了江府。
一名守卫看到邋里邋遢，不修边幅的乞丐，眼中露出了一丝厌恶。
连忙上前，皱了皱眉道：“站住，这里是江家，闲杂人等，不得靠近。”
乞丐跪在地上一脸哀求道：“大哥，行行好吧，我已经几天没吃饭了。”
说完，便一把拽住了守卫的袖子。
守卫正欲发作，却发现手里被塞进了一个触感冰凉的东西。
摊开手一看，是一枚造型精美，一看就价值不菲的玉佩。
“这位大哥，拿着这枚玉佩，去通报你们家主，就说故人求见，他一定会见我的。”
守卫面露为难之色，但看着乞丐那信誓旦旦的眼神。
终究还是咬牙点了点头，只是又说了一句：“你站在这不要动，我这就进去禀报家主，若是发现你诓骗于我，定让你没好果子吃。”
说完，便向同伴使了个眼色，示意同伴看住他，同伴心领神会。
“有劳守卫大哥了。”
乞丐一脸客气的道。
说完，便斜倚在了朱门前那血红色的梁柱上，闭目休息。
江家家主大院内。
家主江成河正在处理族中的琐事。
忽然，守卫来报，说一个乞丐拿着信物说是自己的故人要求见于他。
江成河顿感疑惑。
在他印象中，可没有这样一位乞丐故人。
但在看到守卫递上来的信物玉佩时，脸色却是猛的一变。
他压低了声音道：“你去将人请进来，不得怠慢。”
守卫点了点头，看家主如此郑重的模样，心中暗自庆幸刚才没有得罪那个乞丐。
中年乞丐便被守卫带到了江成河的书房，守卫掩上了房门恭敬的退了出去。
待门关上后。
江成河才开口道：“兄长，为何这副乞丐打扮？”
这乞丐不是别人，正是苏家最后一位长老苏穹。
苏穹叹了一口气道：“躲避李家的搜捕，不得已而为之。”
江成河沉默了。
半天后，才干巴巴的道：“苏家的事我听说了，兄长，请节哀。”
content_en:
The Jiang family is a new family that emerged more than a hundred years ago.
There is currently a Dzogchen monk in the physical realm sitting in the clan.
Its strength is second only to the nine major families in Baihe County.
No, there are eight major families now.
The Jiang family's base camp is in Qishan Town, southeast of Baihe County.
It was dusk and the sun was setting in the west.
In front of the Jiang family's gate, two guards stood with their hands behind their backs, looking intently, while several servants slowly swept the fallen leaves in front of the Zhu's gate.
A middle-aged beggar limped closer to Jiang Mansion.
A guard showed a trace of disgust in his eyes when he saw the slovenly and unkempt beggar.
He hurriedly stepped forward, frowned and said, "Stop, this is the Jiang family. No one is allowed to come near."
The beggar knelt on the ground and begged: "Brother, please do it. I haven't eaten in several days."
After saying that, he grabbed the guard's sleeve.
The guard was about to have a seizure, but found something cold to the touch stuffed into his hand.
When he opened his hand and took a look, he saw that it was a jade pendant that was beautifully shaped and worth a lot of money.
"This eldest brother, take this jade pendant and inform your family master that he is asking for a meeting. He will definitely meet me."
The guard looked embarrassed, but looked at the beggar's confident eyes.
After all, he gritted his teeth and nodded, and just said: "You stand here and don't move. I will go in and report to the head of the family. If I find that you have lied to me, you will definitely suffer no good consequences."
After saying this, he winked at his companion, signaling him to watch him, and he understood.
"It's time to guard brother."
The beggar said politely.
After saying that, he leaned on the blood-red beam in front of the red door and closed his eyes to rest.
In the main courtyard of the Jiang family.
The head of the family, Jiang Chenghe, is dealing with trivial matters in the clan.
Suddenly, the guard came to report that a beggar was holding a token and said he was his old friend who asked to see him.
Jiang Chenghe suddenly felt confused.
In his impression, there was no such old friend who was a beggar.
But when he saw the token jade pendant handed over by the guard, his expression suddenly changed.
He lowered his voice and said, "Go and invite people in, don't neglect them."
The guard nodded. Seeing the solemn look on his face, he was secretly glad that he had not offended the beggar just now.
Soon...
The middle-aged beggar was taken to Jiang Chenghe's study by the guards. The guards closed the door and respectfully left.
After the door closes.
Jiang Chenghe then said: "Brother, why are you dressed like a beggar?"
This beggar is none other than Su Qiong, the last elder of the Su family.
Su Qiong sighed and said, "It is a last resort to avoid being hunted by the Li family."
Jiang Chenghe fell silent.
After a long time, he said dryly: "I heard about the Su family. Brother, please forgive me."
title_en: Chapter 19 Praying to the Shanjiang Family Chapter 20 Eliminating the Remaining Evils of the Su Family
